title: Pin opum-lore and opum-quest at v0.12.0
description: Orchestrator dispatch, 2026-09-30 (opum-agent, go for the LCLI-469 handshake bump): the lore-cli/quest-cli 0.12.0 pair is released, published to npm latest, and qualified -- opum-cli-e2e receipts/pair/0.12.0.json, verdict QUALIFIED, 487 pass / 0 fail / 2 routine-blocked, on pair.lore.commit 739f2b48 and pair.quest.commit 9478e8dd. Bump both federated pins in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json from v0.11.0 to v0.12.0 in one change, per Opum constitution Article 3 clause 4, and re-resolve and record the skills/ subtree baseline for each entry in scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json.

acceptanceCriteria.text: marketplace.json pins opum-lore (lore-cli) and opum-quest (quest-cli) at ref v0.12.0, and the generated Codex mirror .agents/plugins/marketplace.json is current (generate-codex-marketplace.mjs --check exits 0)
scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json records the independently re-resolved skills/ subtree SHA for both entries at v0.12.0, each with a note describing its verification chain

both federated checker scripts pass locally against the new pins (live resolution, not fixtures), all repository test suites pass, and lore check plus lore agents --check exit 0 under lore 0.12.0, the version CI resolves from the new pin
the PR against dev carries the three required contexts (check manifests, Tracker integrity, lore check) as completed successes on its head SHA, evidenced by check-run ids on that exact commit

plan: 1. Re-resolve both tag chains fresh at bump time (ls-remote plus local clone walk plus GitHub API walk) and confirm npm latest on both wrappers and platform packages
2. Update .claude-plugin/marketplace.json refs to v0.12.0 and regenerate the Codex mirror
3. Record both entries in scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json with full chain notes, in one commit
4. Run every local gate: the live federated checkers, the five test suites, lore check and lore agents --check under 0.12.0, and quest tracker checks
5. Push the branch, open the PR to dev, wait for the three required contexts green on the exact head SHA
6. Close the task in the same PR (criteria checked with evidence in hand, final summary citing the PR and the validating run), then squash merge to dev
7. Promote dev to main as ordinary delivery, verify origin/main, and report the PR and the promoted SHA to the orchestrator
implementationNotes: Bump-time resolutions (all fresh, resolved after the day re-cut): lore v0.12.0 -> tag object 070085b0 -> commit 739f2b48 (lore main) -> root 8d512d5c -> skills ce580cd1 (byte-identical to the v0.11.0 baseline); quest v0.12.0 -> tag object cc6abf04 -> commit 9478e8dd (quest main) -> root f48aa7ae -> skills e007a327 (byte-identical to the v0.11.0 baseline). plugin.json at both tags self-declares 0.12.0. npm latest 0.12.0 confirmed on both root launchers and all twelve platform packages. Gates run green locally: check-federated-pins.mjs and check-federated-content.mjs (live, network), the five test suites (44 assertions), lore check and lore agents --check under lore 0.12.0 (0 errors; no schema or managed-block drift), quest task list --json and quest agents --check. No npm provenance attestation on either root launcher (measured absence against a positive control).
